name: Kisaragi Mifuyu
source:
Mifuyu is a refined girl part of the curriculum S in Florence (S for Special); she is very clever but has trouble understanding how to maintain and form relationships. She is the daughter of [url=/c69197]Kisaragi Kazuhiko[/url]. Her family is old and very rich, not to mention Mifuyu knows how to handle a sword. She cares about [url=/c1563]Yumina[/url] quite a lot. [spoiler]She becomes [url=/c69151]Nue[/url]'s mother figure after they overcome their differences.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/03/29/%E3%82%BF%E3%83%A6%E3%82%BF%E3%83%9E-kiss-on-my-deity-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
